reviews.title: Why did I wait to buy this!
reviews.comment: Fantastic monitor. Attachment is super simple, yet extremely solid. I have never had issues with it getting knocked off. The swivel function is smooth and perfect for angled viewing. For someone who travels or wants a 2nd (or 3rd) monitor, this is a must have!
reviews.author: Brendan

reviews.title: Worth the money
reviews.comment: Great upgrade from previous generation. Magnet holds, one cable connection is more convenient. Large screen is a nice to have
reviews.author: EduardoV
